meta.title: About Blake Oxford | Systems Architect
meta.description: Systems architect and workflow strategist—hired for migrations, automation, and decision systems that teams keep running after launch.

hero.title: I build the operating middle that strategy slides skip
hero.description: Based in Michigan. Organizations bring me in when platforms, reporting, and adoption have to move together—and the blast radius has to stay contained. The work is systems architecture with change enablement baked in, not bolted on. I also speak with professional audiences on AI ethics, controls, and agentic risk.
proofPoints: I stay through cutover, not just the architecture deck
I put the new system in the tools people already open
I measure the week after go-live, not the launch party
